title: Space created by events instead of dark energy: a source–sink cosmological model confronted with the data
description:
Spacetime as a causal graph of events: events create space, masses absorb it. This replaces dark energy with a source–sink interacting-vacuum model. With full Planck 2018, DESI DR2 and Pantheon+ it improves the ΛCDM χ² by 8.3–8.8 points, like w0wa but with one parameter fewer (nominal 2.9–3.6 σ depending on the supernova sample). Two independent event clocks (observed star formation; N-body / Press–Schechter collapse) give the same fit. The model predicts a line in the (w0, wa) plane and, if absorption continues, a recollapse in about 45–50 billion years. Includes the article (English and Italian), all analysis code, GPU N-body simulations and exploratory graph experiments.

Draft, not peer reviewed. Developed with the assistance of an AI model (Claude, Anthropic); see the README.
